remarks: Live in Style, Comfort & Unbeatable Convenience! Welcome to this beautifully presented 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhome in the sought-after Newfield East community on Belltown Road. Ideally located just a short stroll from houses of worship and one of Stamford's most charming neighborhood shopping centers, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and easy living. Step inside to discover refinished hardwood floors throughout, a spacious and inviting floor plan, and an abundance of natural light. The main living area opens directly onto your private deck, creating the perfect spot for morning coffee, weekend grilling, relaxing after a long day, or simply enjoying the outdoors. Additional features include in-unit washer and dryer, individual AC units, assigned off-street parking, and ample guest parking for family and friends. And the location is hard to beat. Just steps away, you'll find a grocery store, fresh bakery, inviting restaurants, CVS Pharmacy, and a variety of everyday conveniences. With so much right outside your door, errands, dining, shopping, and daily necessities are remarkably easy. A well-maintained townhome in a highly convenient Stamford location - come see it for yourself! Schedule your private showing today.
